reason: Three manually continued IF conditions in the production template confused FortranWriter indentation; subsequent ELSE statements entered fixed-form label columns. Fresh generated production-template compilation failed. Fixed by supplying each template IF on one line and allowing FortranWriter to wrap it; unchanged control-flow semantics.
log_note: The retained build.log is the actual fixed-form compilation failure. The first CLI generation transcript was overwritten during a follow-up invocation typo; tooling-invocation-error.log records that typo, not the original successful generation. The failed generated source bytes are retained.
